identity.normalizationNote: Packet entries already merge split synonyms (ID-2); every position cited is the normalized one-based position, identical to the packet index + 1.

surfactants.class: strong anionic, alkyl sulfate type (reinforcing route)
strong anionic, ether/sulfonate type - after the E3 point, recorded only (C4)

wLine.derivation: No class a/b/c candidate precedes the E3 marker Parfum@11 (Piroctone Olamine@12 and Sodium Benzoate@14 come after it); no alphabetical run (longest 3). The marker is a class a candidate: (i) SLES@2 before it; (ii) nothing between it and the cap -> W-line = cap = 11, no fallback code. The formula has no payload_lipid, so the W-line gates nothing.

cleansingStrength.rationale: strong by C1: the defining anionic Sodium Laureth Sulfate@2 (ether type) is reinforced by a second prominent strong anionic, Sodium Lauryl Sulfate@3 (reinforcing route -> strong); Cocamidopropyl Betaine@6 buffers but cannot change the convention. TEA-Dodecylbenzenesulfonate@16 is after the E3 point and recorded only.

conditioningLevel.rationale: high: C2 is met in a strong chassis (C2 says cleansing strength does not lower conditioning) - early (prominent) silicone Dimethiconol@10 (with Dimethicone@13), cationic polymer Guar Hydroxypropyltrimonium Chloride@15, pearlizing route Glycol Distearate@7 and the deliberate humectant Panthenol@24 (own entry). This is the holdout-v3 C2 pattern. Counter-signal: the guar, second silicone and Panthenol sit after Parfum@11 and Panthenol is near the end of the list; one silicone/guar coacervate system with a pearlizer is the core, so moderate is the realistic neighbor.

weightPotential.rationale: moderate: one meaningfully persistent system - silicone (Dimethiconol@10, Dimethicone@13) deposited with cationic guar (@15) - in a strong SLES+SLS chassis (resetCapacity strong). W1 does not apply (no late amodimethicone: the set is incomplete, so W1 is not cited as support). No payload lipid, so no W-RICH; the convergence route (silicone + cationic polymer) is offset by strong reset.

reset: Sodium Lauryl Sulfate@3 (strong, alkyl sulfate - reinforcing)
excluded: Magnesium Nitrate@28, Magnesium Chloride@34 (isothiazolinone stabilizer salts)

weightPotential.counterevidence: Silicone + guar is a deliberate coacervate deposition system and two silicone types are present, which argues toward high.
weightPotential.whyThisBand: A silicone/guar deposition system plausibly leaves bounded residue (lightweight would understate it), while a reinforced strong sulfate chassis removes build-up and there is no lipid, quat, protein or film former converging.
weightPotential.whyNotNeighborBand: high needs W-RICH with weak reset or converging persistent systems not offset by reset; there is no lipid (no W-RICH), the deposition is a single silicone/guar system, and the reset is strong.
weightPotential.confidenceLimitingFactor: Silicone/guar deposition efficiency from INCI alone is uncertain; two silicones plus guar could be read as converging persistent systems (neighbor high).

usageRole.rationale: PROVISIONAL (formula-only): regular, the default (Section 9). Every non-default trigger needs a moderate/high-graded claim or direction (CL-SRC), hidden in the blind pass. treatment becomes possible because dandruffSupport is supported (needs a qualifying E2 dandruff claim, U3); alternating possible with reset intent (strong formula); occasional_reset with D1.

scalpComfortTarget.rationale: PROVISIONAL (formula-only): not_targeted, because SC1 positioning (an E2 sensitive/dry claim unit graded moderate/high) cannot be seen in the blind pass. Formula half (CSA) recorded for reconciliation: CSA would fail - no prominent E4 comfort route and no prominent humectant/refatting route (Panthenol@24 and Niacinamide@30 are after Parfum@11). Counter-signals: cleansingStrength strong; declared Parfum with allergens; MCI/MIT preservatives.

dandruffSupport.rationale: supported: the complete INCI contains Piroctone Olamine@12, a recognized anti-dandruff active (Section 11 table; DS1 for selenium sulfide). Formula-only property, final in the blind pass; whether a dandruff target is projected depends on the claim (S-DANDRUFF, R17.3).
